For your first time wearing Invisalign clear aligners: 
Wear them for about 20–22 hours a day.
Remove them only for eating, brushing, and flossing.
Follow your doctor’s instructions so treatment stays on track.

Your doctor’s instructions take priority because your aligners are prescribed for your individual treatment plan.
